children: Harshavardhan V. Agadi, a director, sold 3,667 shares through the GHS Defined Benefit Plan at $25.00 per share and 29,710 shares directly at a weighted average price of $25.354 per share on November 18, 2026. The sales totaled $844,942. After the transactions, Agadi directly owned 157,654 shares and indirectly owned 15,000 shares through an IRA Account; the GHS Defined Benefit Plan no longer held any shares.
